visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static shot of a white motorcycle parked on a busy city street at night. A large cartoon goose animation is superimposed on the bike, accompanied by bold variety-show style text. (2) Transition to a female rider on the motorcycle moving through Taichung city traffic at dusk. She is wearing a white T-shirt, grey pleated skirt, and a distinctive full-face helmet with a white teeth pattern on the jaw. (3) A close-up view of the motorcycle's digital dashboard shows red warning lights turning on. The rider, still in motion, looks down at the controls as traffic flows around her. (4) The camera shifts to a handheld perspective as the rider pulls over to the side of the road and attempts to restart the engine by pressing the ignition. The bike fails to respond. (5) The rider is seen pushing the heavy motorcycle along the red-painted curb. The lighting shifts from a dim evening sky to bright night-time street lamps and neon signs. (6) Now standing on the sidewalk without her helmet, the short-haired woman talks to the camera, gesturing with her hands while holding a smartphone. (7) A silver van arrives and parks in front of her. Two men get out and open the rear hatch. The background is a mix of urban buildings and city lights. (8) The men help the woman load the white motorcycle into the back of the van. The video concludes with shots of the bike secured inside and the van's doors closing.
